► The most ambitious gameplay mod ◄
This mod will be the reference in gameplay. It will offer many option to enjoy the game. Thus, everyone will find his way of playing: No XP, balanced mod, nightmare mod, ... It provides also simple change for everyone that just want specific change on their vanilla game. With this mod you can make the following modification:
◆ General option ◆ • Language: For the moment only English works, except for gerogero uncensored.
◆ Monster rework (Until Ifrit) ◆ • MonsterRework: Stat rework (Mathematical improved formula and stat change) + AI rework
◆ Cronos Rework ◆ • EncountersRework: Change all encounters in the game • FieldRework: Change fields data like dialog, quest, save point position,.. • MngrpRework: GF refine abilities • ShopRework: Shop rework • StartData: The data you start with • DrawPoint: The draw point magic/quantity • KernelRework: Change magic/item/weapon/abilities/monster attack/... • WIP: For testers
◆ Game fix ◆ • BahamutRareItem: Now actually increase the probability of really rare item. • GerogeroUncensoredMenu: Use the japanese version without color change. • GerogeroUncensoredBattle: Use the japanese version without color change. • TrueRandomness: Use a real random generator. • SquallComputeHit: Make squall fail sometimes !
◆ Quality of life ◆ • DamageCap: All damage can deal up to 65.535 (Eden damage is also cap to 65.535). • NoMagicDepletion: Using magic doesn't decrease your stock. • 255AP: Earn 255 AP after battle. • SaveAnywhere: To be able to save in field. Use at your own risk !
◆ Little gameplay mod ◆ • NoXP: Don't earn any XP at end of battle. • TripleTryhard: Card values changed for a challenge. => To be tested • QueenForest: Queen of cards and Chocobo forest updated to be more convenient => To be tested

Don't divide magic monster damage by 2. • JunctionRework: Junction value is linked to level or min between the level and the number of magic junctionned. • DrawRework: Change the draw logic(Either draw more than 9 or draw 100) • 255HitCanFail: Make that weapon can fail even at 255%.
◆ Dev setup ◆ • AddRandomVar: Allow modders to use random numbers in the AI.
◆ Special thanks ◆ • myst6re for Deling tool and RE work • Nihil for AI, stat, encounter rework • Malekith for stat rework • Unicorngoulash for LimitBreakNotRefreshable • AxlRoses for the awesome preview • Maki for his work on RE • Dulca for TripleTryHard and QueenForest • Dangerous Dom for beta testing

Mod.Name: Ragnarok
Mod.Author: Callisto
Mod.Description:
This mod was created with the aim of rebalancing several gameplay aspects of Final Fantasy VIII, such as the usefulness of all characters in battle, the power level of Limit Breaks, and the ways of obtaining powerful tools to become stronger. Not only does this mod limit the gains from playing Triple Triad or make enemies more challenging, but it also adds various convenience functions not present in the original game, such as lifting the Draw cap in battles, providing additional save possibilities, or giving the characters basic spells right off the bat.
Overall, the mod is for those who look for a new challenge and maybe those who would like to relive Final Fantasy VIII the way they did during their very first playthrough, when they didn't know the game inside out yet. Of course, new players are welcome as well, but they should get accustomed to how the general gameplay mechanics work first.
The mod has been playtested from start to finish and should be largely bug-free. If you give this mod a try and discover something off, please report it on the forum or Discord.
To check if the mod is working, you should have magic already available when launching a new game. In battles, you should have no problem drawing more than 10 spells per Draw for low-level magic, such as Cure, Fire, or Blizzard.

Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] GameplayCustomizer
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► The ultimate gameplay tweaks ◄
Customize FF8's gameplay with options to suit your preferences!
◆ Quality of life ◆ • Damage cap increased: Bring the damage cap up to 65.535. • No magic depletion: Using magic doesn't decrease your stock. • Draw - Battle: Choose normal battle drawing, uncapped drawing based on MAG, or Draw 100. • Draw - Field: Draw 100 from field draw points, up to your stock limit. • Draw - World map: Draw 100 from world-map draw points, up to your stock limit. • Keep junctions in dreams: Dream characters inherit their normal counterparts' full junction setups. • AP modifier: Choose an AP multiplier or earn 255 AP after each battle. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • EXP modifier: Earn from 0 EXP to x16 EXP. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • Save anywhere: Allow to save in any field, but keep a side save on normal save point to be sure.
◆ Game fix ◆ • Bahamut rare item: Fix rare item drop and mug probabilities. • True randomness: Make random outcomes less predictable instead of repeating the game's usual random sequence.
◆ Difficulty balance ◆ • Limit break not refreshable: Prevent repeatedly switching characters to make a limit break appear. • No GF Heal: GFs can only recover HP through items, instead of walking or staying at hotels. • Junction value rework: Base junction bonuses on character level, or on the lower of character level and magic stock. • Selphie can miss: Allow Selphie's attacks to miss, including with her ultimate weapon. • Squall can miss: Allow Squall and Seifer's attacks to miss, with Blind reducing their accuracy. • Individual EXP: Calculate battle EXP from each character's own level, helping lower-level party members catch up. • GF level cap: Limit GF EXP growth according to the level of their junctioned character. • No pause during Zell's Duel: Disable pausing during Zell's Duel limit break.
